note: Frozen snapshot of the production risk/execution geometry. The live engine reads these values from config.json and from code defaults; this file exists so CONTROL can be measured, hashed and diffed by the Phase 6 offline experiment WITHOUT ever being rewritten. tests/phase6.test.mjs fails if this file and production ever disagree.

trailing.note: live engine order: liquidation -> stop -> target -> time -> trailing (engine.mjs managePositions)

fees.note: taker on entry AND exit; maker is never assumed by the offline resolver

slippage.note: half of this value is applied adversely on entry and exit, PLUS sqrt market-impact slippageFraction(); both come from perp.mjs

leverage.note: Leverage is a RISK parameter, not a geometry axis: it is FIXED at CONTROL for every experiment (Phase 6 §3).

aggression.note: campaign keys, NOT used by the offline resolver

liquidation.model: isolated margin, maintenanceMargin(N,tier) = |N|*mmr - deduction; trigger inclusive on the adverse extreme (perp.mjs)

noteOnPromptAssumption: The Phase 6 brief describes CONTROL as a uniform 5% stop / 10% target. That is NOT the production geometry: stopPct/targetPct are per-strategy (see perStrategyGeometry). This snapshot records the true values; the experiment scales each strategy's OWN stop/target.
